prebakes.name: node-smol-base
consumers: node-smol builder (+ COPY --from=ghcr.io/socketdev/node-base for the .mts driver)
prebakes.purpose: The heavy Node.js/V8 compile environment, on top of the wheelhouse c-base. Split into its own layer for CACHE LOCALITY: the toolchain rarely changes, the Node source changes every version bump. The .mts driver's node comes via COPY --from=node-base, not a baked runtime.
